  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂

  | par a a' b b' ha' hb' ihA ihB =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a' ⬝ b', .refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := ihA ha''
      let ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := ihB hb''
      exact ⟨a₃ ⬝ b₃, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', .refl _⟩
    case red_K =>
      let ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      rw [ha₂'.2]
      exact ⟨a₂', .red_K a₂' b', ha₂'.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      let ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'

    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .red_I _⟩

      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      exact ⟨a₁', ha, .red_I _⟩

  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      let ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      exact ⟨a₃ ⬝ b₃, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha']
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', .refl _⟩
    case red_K =>
      let ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      rw [ha₂'.2]
      exact ⟨a₂', .red_K a₂' b', ha₂'.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      let ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'
      rw [h.2.2]
      exact ⟨a'' ⬝ b' ⬝ (c' ⬝ b'), .red_S a'' c' b', by
        apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> simp_all only⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂ <;> simp_all [I_irreducible]
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => use a₁; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      let ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [h'.2]
      use a₁'
      exact ⟨h'.1, .red_K a₁' c'⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      exact ⟨a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c'), by
        apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.1 hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc, .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _⟩
